description: This file contains an implementation of the nanoid ID generator, including functions for customizable alphabet-based IDs, cryptographically secure random IDs, and related utilities, specifically optimized for browser environments.

methods.name: customRandom
methods.description: Generates a function to produce random IDs based on a custom alphabet, size, and method to get randomness.

methods.name: customAlphabet
methods.description: Creates a custom ID generator function with a specific alphabet and size.

methods.name: nanoid
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random ID string of a specified size.
